items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Do you remember, Dizzy was on it, Carmen (McRae), Dave Brubeck. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, she is. And I remember the first time I came out to California, I went to a recording session of her's. And she said, 'Oh Helen, I'm just so glad to see you'. She had just had a little baby, you know.
Oh, she was married to Dave.
Yeah. And she had a little girl. She said, 'you know, every night I have to sing my baby to sleep with your song'. 'Ebobbaleeba.'
